Job Description:- 
 5- 7 yrs experience in - J2EE with Spring MVC Good knowledge of REST API and JSON 
 JBOSS EAP 6.X Strong experience in Big Data using hbase on hadoop 
 Strong skills in designing mapreduce jobs to work on large amount of hbase data and 
 importing in into hbase database 
 Unix shell scripting skills to pre-process large amounts of unstructured data that will be 
 processed and imported into hbase 
 Designing REST based Get calls on hbase to retrieve data Hadoop Java programming 
 background using Mapreduce, HBase, pig, hive, APIs, etc. 
 Linux and Distributed systems management Knowledge of Active MQ Good trouble shooting 
 aptitude and knowledge Good communication skill 
 

 Basic Qualifications :- 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 At least 7 years of experience within the Information Technologies. 
 
 ** U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply . We are unable to sponsor at this time. 
 Note:- 
 This is a  FULL TIME   job oppurtunity.
 Only  US Citizen ,  Green Card Holder ,  GC-EAD ,  H4-EAD ,  L2-EAD ,  TN VIsa  can apply.
 No  OPT-EAD  &  H1-B   for this position.
 Please mention your Visa Status in your  email   or  resume .
